summary: As a backend developer automating WhatsApp messaging, I experience session expiry frequently but the pain is not severe enough to pay for a solution. I prefer free open-source workarounds or custom scripts, even if they require occasional manual intervention. The willingness to pay is very low, and I would not purchase a commercial product for this problem.
strongest_points: The problem is real and occurs frequently (session expiry every 24 hours or due to IP bans).
Current workarounds (custom scripts, headless browsers) are fragile and require maintenance.
Open-source libraries like whatsapp-web.js and Baileys partially address session persistence but still need manual re-auth.
weaknesses: Pain intensity is low (2/5) – downtime is annoying but not critical; I can tolerate occasional manual re-scan.
Willingness to pay is very low (1/5) – I expect a free or near-free solution for a personal automation tool.
Existing free alternatives (open-source libraries, DIY scripts) are good enough for my needs, even if not fully automatic.
